residual_findings.title: Cmd/Ctrl+S save triggers can replay on later renders, duplicating inspector mutations (Warning)
residual_findings.note: useEffect depends on saveTrigger + handleSave; handleSave is recreated every render; saveTrigger never resets. Can issue duplicate PATCH + extra revision bumps + avoidable 409s. Fix: edge-trigger via lastHandledTriggerRef, or reset trigger after consumption, or stable handleSave via useCallback.
residual_findings.closure_note: Applied edge-trigger guard: each inspector now tracks the last handled saveTrigger value in a ref and only invokes handleSave for unseen values. This prevents duplicate PATCH calls when the inspector re-renders while the trigger is still non-zero. Regression test added in inspector-save-trigger.test.tsx verifies StateInspector/EdgeInspector/PromptInspector each call their patch mutation exactly once per trigger value across multiple renders.

residual_findings.title: Signing/notarization failures do not preserve/upload unsigned fallback artifact (Warning)
residual_findings.note: Packaging/upload only runs after signing/notarize/staple succeed. Unsigned DMG is removed during signed DMG recreation. Fix: copy unsigned DMG to fallback path before signing; packaging/upload runs with always() condition and uploads signed DMG when signing succeeds, otherwise fallback unsigned DMG; add step-level timeouts for keychain/codesign/notarize/staple so cleanup runs before overall timeout.
residual_findings.closure_note: Workflow updated: unsigned DMG is copied to Nexus-unsigned-fallback.dmg before signing; packaging and upload steps run with always()&&steps.bundle.outcome=='success' and select signed DMG when staple succeeds, fallback unsigned DMG otherwise, with a clear error annotation; step-level timeouts (20 min) added to keychain creation, codesign, DMG recreation, notarization, and staple so the cleanup step still runs before the 120-minute job timeout. actionlint passes with no new issues.

residual_findings.title: React useEffect deps churn in inspector save handlers (Warning, cosmetic)
residual_findings.note: PM accepts as cosmetic residual. Early-exit guards prevent actual double-saves. Fix in V1.73 (wrap handleSave in useCallback with proper deps, or use ref-based trigger pattern). Subsumed by R-V172P1-QC3-001 fix-wave which addresses root cause.
